judgments.reason: Frauscher et al. 2018 is the wakefulness atlas paper named in the README; it reports the same 106-patient MNI Open iEEG Atlas data, with matching authors and 60-second artifact-free clips.
judgments.paper_title: Atlas of the normal intracranial electroencephalogram: neurophysiological awake activity in different cortical areas

judgments.reason: The dataset README names von Ellenrieder et al. 2020 (Ann Neurol) as the atlas sleep paper. This paper reports the sleep iEEG recordings (N2, N3, REM) in this atlas release.
judgments.paper_title: How the Human Brain Sleeps: Direct Cortical Recordings of Normal Brain Activity

judgments.reason: The Ann Neurol 2018 normal-HFO paper reports the high-sampling-rate sEEG, which the README says is a separate raw dataset, not this processed 200 Hz clips dataset.
judgments.paper_title: High‐Frequency Oscillations in the Normal Human Brain
